Inside a three-cycle thermal prediction

Trained v13 operator · fixed-budget historical benchmark

Explore SMA and fluid temperature fields across six heat-exchange stages. Switch between the numerical reference, autonomous prediction and error. These are v13 predictions after 200 joint-training updates. The fixed seed and case were declared before training; all three seeds and both three-cycle cases are reported separately.

浏览三循环中的六段换热过程，可切换数值参考、模型预测和误差。此处为 v13 完成 200 次联合训练后的预测，工况及种子在训练前固定；正式报告另外覆盖全部三种子及两个三循环工况。

Evidence / 来源

The slider reveals a stored field; it does not run a new solver or a new inference. Statistics use the full segment, omit the initial frame for RMSE, and use data rounded to 4 decimals for display. The selected case and seed are fixed, not chosen for low error. Temperature fields are 1-D space × time, not a measured 2-D plate surface.

滑块展示保存的场数据，不触发新仿真或新推理。统计覆盖完整换热段，RMSE 排除初始帧；页面数据保留四位小数。固定工况和种子未按误差挑选。温度图的两个维度为空间与时间，并非二维板面测量。
